Name: Uzzi, Son of Bela
Summary: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:7: Son of Bela and head of his father's house, a mighty man of valour.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzzi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
